name: gateswarm
description: Score task complexity, distribute work across models and providers, grade the results, and recalibrate the routing matrix from those grades.

project.title: Project slug
project.description: Groups telemetry and quality votes. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

telemetry_dir.title: Telemetry directory
telemetry_dir.description: Where decisions and quality votes are stored. Defaults to ~/.gateswarm/telemetry.

matrix_path.title: Model matrix
matrix_path.description: Optional ModelSpec[] JSON describing the models and providers you can actually reach. Without it, the built-in demo matrix is used.
